    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)

    q = QuantumRegister(len(graph_vertices), 'q')
    c = ClassicalRegister(len(graph_vertices), 'c')

    qc = QuantumCircuit(q, c)

    beta = qml.exp(-0.5 * qml.PauliZ(q[i]) * qml.PauliZ(q[j]) * penalty * (1 - dimod.BINARY[G.edge[i][j]]))(wires=[q[i], q[j]], parameters=w) for i, j in G.edges())
    alpha = qml.RX(w[i])(wires=q[i]) for i in range(len(graph_vertices))

    qc.h(q)

        return -np.sum([counts[state] for state in dimod.BINARY[G.edges()] if G.is_edge(state[0], state[1])])
